title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

## Problem and user / Sorun ve kullanıcı

Who needs this, what work is blocked and what observable outcome would help?

## Proposed behavior / Önerilen davranış

Describe the smallest complete responsibility and the human/AI surfaces it affects.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs / Alternatifler ve kazanım-kayıp

Include existing mechanisms, the cost of acting/waiting and reasons to defer if evidence is missing.

## Acceptance and limits / Kabul ve sınırlar

What would prove the outcome, including failure paths? Which authority/scope/security boundaries apply?
Separate desired Enterprise/ERP integration from open Core responsibilities.

## Related work / İlgili iş

Existing PLAN card or issue, if any. This is a proposal: owner admission is required before implementation.
